annotations.title: The sky now: positions, Moon phase, next events

description: The sky now (no location needed): planet positions, retrograde planets and the Moon phase, plus the exact UTC minute of the next stations, lunations and separations. E.g. {datetime: '2026-10-01T00:00Z', days: 30}. One call for 'what is happening in the sky': positions, retrograde planets, the Moon's phase, and the events of the next days (1-90): stations, lunations, separations of 0, 60, 90, 120 and 180 degrees, and ecliptic longitudes crossing multiples of 30 degrees, each to the minute (UTC). Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/sky (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

ambiguous_time.description: Which occurrence to use when a local time happens twice (DST fall-back).

datetime.description: Local civil date-time, ISO 8601: '1990-05-15T14:30' (local clock time at the place) or with an explicit offset '1990-05-15T14:30:00+02:00'. Alternative: 'date' + 'time'.

days.description: How many days ahead to list events. Example: 30.

time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, 24 h. Omit if unknown (computed at 12:00 with a TIME_UNKNOWN warning).

time_basis.description: What the given clock time is: civil wall-clock (default), UTC, Local Mean Time, or true (apparent) solar time.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.

name: sky_now

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'astronomy/rise-set'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

counts.description: Number of events of each type.

events.description: Events in time order, each with 'type' (eclipse, lunation, station, separation, longitude_crossing, declination, declination_beyond_obliquity), its details, 'exact_utc'.

now.description: The sky at the moment: 'points' (positions, speeds, retrograde flags), 'retrograde' (bodies retrograde now) and 'moon' (elongation, phase name, illumination, waxing).

settings.description: Settings applied: days ahead, the bodies, the separation angles searched, the longitude reference and the precision of event times.

subject.description: The resolved input: 'time' (local input, time zone and historical UTC offset, UT, Julian days, Delta T) and, when given, 'location' (latitude, longitude).

warnings.description: Notes on the input or the calculation (for example an assumed local noon when only a date is given). Present only when there is something to say.
